description: Discord's historical record of administrative actions: who did what, to what, when, and why. Use this to investigate what already happened; for activity as it happens use subscribe_events. Filter by action name (like channel_create, member_ban_add, message_delete) or by the acting user.

action.description: Action name filter, like channel_delete or member_kick.

guild.description: Guild (server) name or ID. Omit to use the default guild.

user.description: Only entries by this user (name or ID).
